question: Does the fixed clean-room amplitude-matched donor improve the visible, severe-safe generic interimage contribution over its exact linear-donor control after the same P7F physical and AO6 colour chain?
claim_ceiling: generic physical-inspired fixed photographic mechanism comparison on rights-cleared display-sRGB photographs; not measured chemistry, stock/process/scanner response, calibration, authenticity or product promotion

fixed_operator.stage: after exposure-domain forward scatter and before characteristic development
fixed_operator.density_normalization: per-channel frozen sensitometry curve minimum and maximum

analytical_domain_safety.rule: per-pixel largest common donor scale in [0,1] that keeps all corrected log-exposure channels at or above the frozen zero-exposure boundary

fixed_operator.downstream_chain: unchanged P7F adjacency, dye diffusion, interpretation, scanner MTF, neutral gauge and AO6 colour

forbidden_fallbacks: change the donor knee, match point, coupling, placement, physical chain, AO6 colour, population, sampling or gates after execution
fit any parameter on photographs or external rendered outputs
remove difficult photographs or add visual rounds
advance to visual review if any automatic gate fails
call the result measured DIR chemistry, a stock/process/scanner response, calibration or product promotion

execution_amendments.trigger: pre-formal one-crop smoke exposed that unbounded donor subtraction can leave the zero-exposure sensitometry domain before P7F adjacency
execution_amendments.change: freeze the analytical maximum common donor scale above; no photographic metric, rendered output or gate was observed
execution_amendments.scientific_effect: preserves donor direction and all frozen parameters while making domain safety explicit; it may only weaken the mechanism near the zero-exposure boundary

branch_rule.automatic_fail: close fixed photographic use without strength, coupling, placement or threshold rescue
branch_rule.automatic_pass: open one blind severe/preference comparison; keep production unchanged
branch_rule.visual_severe_fail: close photographic use and retain P2V primitive only
branch_rule.visual_clean: retain development challenger evidence and require independent OOD confirmation before any runtime consideration
